draft.emotion: furrowed brow and a quiet, tense tone, feeling uneasy about the situation
notes: To say what or whom you are worried about, use the preposition 'um' (+ accusative): 'Ich bin besorgt um dich' (I am worried about you).
Do not confuse the adjective 'besorgt' with the past participle of 'besorgen' (to get/obtain), e.g., 'Ich habe die Tickets besorgt' (I got the tickets).
